events.title: Holladay Christkindl Fest
events.blurb: A holiday craft market with kids' activities. On Friday, Santa arrives at 6 p.m. for the tree lighting and fireworks.
events.blurbEs: Un mercado navideño de artesanías con actividades para niños. El viernes, Santa llega a las 6 p.m. para el encendido del árbol y los fuegos artificiales.

events.title: Holiday Lights on the Diamond
events.addr: 501 W South St, South Bend, IN 46601
events.blurb: Walk through a million lights at the South Bend Cubs' ballpark, with holiday train rides, a s'mores station and Santa and Mrs. Claus. Parking is free.
events.blurbEs: Recorre un millón de luces en el estadio de los South Bend Cubs, con paseos en tren navideño, estación de s'mores y Santa y la Sra. Claus. El estacionamiento es gratis.

events.title: Notre Dame Hockey vs. Boston College
events.addr: Compton Family Ice Arena, Notre Dame, IN 46556
events.blurb: The Fighting Irish host Boston College in a Black Friday afternoon game.
events.blurbEs: Los Fighting Irish reciben a Boston College en un partido la tarde del Black Friday.

events.title: Notre Dame Men's Basketball vs. Stonehill
events.blurb: The Irish play Stonehill on Saturday during a long home stretch. Tip time had not been posted when we checked.
events.blurbEs: Los Irish juegan contra Stonehill el sábado durante una larga serie de partidos en casa. La hora de inicio aún no estaba publicada cuando revisamos.

events.title: The Bergamot – A South Shore Christmas
events.addr: 211 N Michigan St, South Bend, IN 46601
events.blurb: The husband-and-wife duo and their full band play Christmas standards and original songs, a holiday tradition at the Morris since 2017.
events.blurbEs: El dúo de esposos y su banda completa tocan clásicos navideños y canciones originales, una tradición en el Morris desde 2017.

events.title: A Very Merry Symphony Sleigh Ride Adventure
events.addr: DeBartolo Performing Arts Center, Notre Dame, IN 46556
events.blurb: A family holiday concert by the South Bend Symphony with music from traditions around the world. Come early for a holiday craft.
events.blurbEs: Un concierto navideño familiar de la South Bend Symphony con música de tradiciones de todo el mundo. Llega temprano para hacer una manualidad navideña.

events.title: South Bend Museum of Art
events.addr: 120 S Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd, South Bend, IN 46601
events.blurb: Free galleries in the Century Center on the St. Joseph River downtown. Closed Thanksgiving Day, open Friday through Sunday afternoons.
events.blurbEs: Galerías gratuitas en el Century Center junto al río St. Joseph, en el centro. Cerrado el Día de Acción de Gracias; abre de viernes a domingo por la tarde.

events.title: Small Business Saturday in Downtown South Bend
events.addr: 219 S St Louis Blvd, South Bend, IN
events.blurb: Start at the welcome tent at Howard Park, next to the Howard Holiday Market, for free tote bags, coffee, donuts and a list of downtown deals.
events.blurbEs: Empieza en la carpa de bienvenida en Howard Park, junto al Howard Holiday Market, con bolsas gratis, café, donas y una lista de ofertas del centro.

events.title: Potawatomi Zoo
events.addr: 500 S Greenlawn Ave, South Bend, IN 46615
events.blurb: Indiana's oldest zoo is open through Sunday, its last weekend of the season. Holly Days with Santa start Saturday and Sunday, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m.
events.blurbEs: El zoológico más antiguo de Indiana abre hasta el domingo, su último fin de semana de temporada. Holly Days con Santa empieza el sábado y domingo, de 11 a.m. a 4 p.m.

events.title: Basilica of the Sacred Heart & Grotto
events.addr: Basilica of the Sacred Heart, Notre Dame, IN 46556
events.blurb: Notre Dame's Gothic basilica, the Grotto and the Golden Dome.
events.blurbEs: La basílica gótica de Notre Dame, la Gruta y la Cúpula Dorada.

upcoming.title: Holiday Pops with the South Bend Symphony
